title: Recover the secant line of two points by elimination

source.citation: Jessica Sidman and Peter Vermeire, Equations defining secant varieties: geometry and computation, arXiv:0910.0989

translation.notes: This translates the paper's explicit two-point illustration of the Sturmfels-Sullivant secant construction. Noether certifies the elimination result. The paper's genus-two secant ideal and Betti table require a secant-variety constructor and are not claimed here.
